detail.longDescription:
Meeting.ai is your all-in-one AI agent for meetings and work. It records, transcribes, and turns every meeting into actionable insight — then goes beyond notes to actually do work for you.

NEVER JUST A NOTETAKER

Meeting.ai captures your meetings from Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, or in person with your phone mic. You get a live transcript with speaker labels, an AI summary, key points, action items, and a Visual Note — a one-of-a-kind visual summary you can download and share.

AN AI AGENT THAT DOES THE WORK

Meeting.ai isn't just a chatbot. It's a persistent AI agent that keeps working even after you close the app. Ask it to create a slide deck from your meeting notes, research a topic, build a spreadsheet, generate an image, or produce a podcast-style audio summary — and it handles the whole task end to end.

Because Meeting.ai remembers your meetings, it has the context to deliver results that are actually useful. It knows who you talked to, what was discussed, and what was decided.

INSTALLABLE SKILLS

Extend your agent with skills — installable capabilities that each add a new power. Create presentations, draft documents, research competitors, build charts, generate images, or publish a website. New skills are added regularly, so your agent keeps getting smarter.

KEY FEATURES

• Record meetings live — a bot joins Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or Webex automatically
• Record in person with your phone mic and get real-time transcription
• Upload audio or video files (MP3, WAV, MP4, MOV, and more)
• AI-generated summary, key points, and action items for every meeting
• Visual Notes — a unique visual summary of each meeting
• Voice Match — speaker recognition with editable labels
• AI agent chat with your full meeting history as context
• Persistent agent — keeps working after you close the app
• Installable skills for slides, documents, spreadsheets, research, images, podcasts, and more
• File management — all your agent's outputs in one place
• Calendar integration — auto-join scheduled meetings
• Contact book with meeting history per person
• Share meetings via link or email
• 106 transcription languages with auto-detect
• 14 app interface languages
• Available on iOS, Android, web, and desktop

WHO IT'S FOR

Professionals who want to stop taking notes and start acting on them. Sales teams, consultants, founders, researchers, project managers, and anyone whose work lives in meetings.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

Every user gets their own isolated agent instance. Your meetings, files, and preferences are private to you — never shared across accounts.

GET STARTED

Download Meeting.ai, sign in, and join your first meeting. The agent handles the rest.
